notes.title: 《Infinity Fantasy》 Round 0 iteration
notes.content:
System module 
 Custom Role Module 
1. Customize the background of the role
You can customize your character's background with limited (optional) aura values, including character stats, backstory bonuses, adventures, opening resources, story, and more.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291771/e9fb77a950ba58c4a14ebb70658d535353800a58.png
 Dialog module 
1. It can trigger dialogue interactively
In dialogue, when faced with a choice, you can choose the choice you like to continue the story.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291771/5aa58fd272889101efe2568f8e053fd350bbf37d.png
 Role Control module 
1. Basic control of the character: movement, squat, jump, running, etc
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291771/6ce998177b63f8321a911da89bda3655b7a5842d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291771/1e3f511118884a2ed4a100e253dd0d4e84ceae7c.png
 Combat Module 
1. Combo
You can attack in succession and form a combo
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291771/0b81939d97902e16bfc842f6dabf6bc876aa8662.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291771/547f8cfcd60e2302b950923a27b95a165c24bd97.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291771/d1606ac55395fb8cb59c6505efa3b4781a56a895.png
Step 2 Fight back
When the enemy attacks, you can launch a counterattack to interrupt the enemy
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291771/bb749836af6e0a994c7a214afcf7aab4f2b30784.png
3. Mid-range attack (flying kick)
When you are within a certain distance of the enemy, you will launch a medium and close range attack, such as a flying kick.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291771/dd4d77ca5973d966aa56e3a39b68083467e08b89.png
4. Lock mode
You can press V to enter lock mode, which automatically locks the nearest unit in the crosshair, and then your character's movement will revolve around the target.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291771/9262685f2abee838f3d96d37f3bcf79f9f2a2985.png
 Firing module 
1. Basic functions related to firearms: shooting, changing bullets, bullet properties, projectile effect, bullet hit effect, weapon switching, etc
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291771/f5ae2f504eaeac3e11d0b66e6eff75d7ff1b12f3.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291771/d8608194b8e6afd9ff6a0e5d37c2c9fc72a47d39.png
AI module 
1. AI for various objects
Each type of object has a specific AI, such as ordinary NPCS, which will wander around looking for an opportunity to attack (especially when multiple of these intelligent NPCS are besieged). The zombie AI will attack regardless.
2. AI that executes player commands
You can issue some simple commands to the members of your community (the base), such as follow me, protect me, stay where you are.
3. Make deals, give gifts, and receive assignments
For some NPCS, you can trade with them for resources, give them gifts, accept their quests to increase favorability and get rewards, or even recruit them into your community.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291771/0b66024a5fb844d4bfa706a77f274f44bbcbe495.png

 Interactive module 
1. Interactive items
You can interact with items in the world, some simple items, such as food, fruit, you can pick up directly into the backpack. For some complex items, such as refrigerators, you can have more complex interactions after you trigger the interaction, maybe there is some storage inside.

In the community interface, you can understand the basic situation of the current community: resources, people, buildings, etc

 Camera module 
1. Third person and first person camera design
 Data persistence 
1. Role archive
You can save your game progress to a document and then read the save to continue the game the next time you start the game.
 Other 
 Minimap 
You can get some information from the small map

 Settings

 Version Description 
The main tasks of this version are framework system design and prototype function development.
 Development focus 
Build a basic framework to build a basic game world, which can be developed and tested with various system modules.
Due to the upgrade from 2D game to 3D in the later stage of development, many functions based on 2D game need to be reconstructed. Some functions, such as core gameplay modules such as community module and construction module, need to be rebuilt due to workload problems. [After upgrading to 3D, the development focus has shifted from core module development to 3D game basic module. For example, the camera (third person, first person), character control, etc.), postponed to the next version of the reconstruction and development.
There was no extensive testing, and only bugs that significantly affected the game were addressed. Some small functions and bugs, such as UI data not refreshed in time, data layer interaction missing, etc. will be solved in the development test of subsequent versions. Avoid greatly slowing down development due to testing and excessive attention to side detail.

 Next version development plan 
 Development focus 
Core gameplay development
Includes the following system modules:
1. Limited Open Worlds 
The expected development effect here is that the world has designed the actual installation of items and props, and can be linked with the data of the production system. Second, there are designed NPCS that can talk, trade, quests, give gifts (increase favorability), and recruit.
2. Free construction 
1) It can build formed buildings (such as beds and worktables), and the walls and floors can be connected, adsorbed and rotated.
2) Allow community NPCS to work
3. Attacks and Accidents 
1) A variety of attacks, base attacks, adventure encountered sudden enemy attacks
2) Design accidents and adventures with log system.
4. (Optional) Growable NPCS 
1) NPCS generated by random algorithms, and have specific attributes such as personality and talent
2) Have a unique growth process according to their own circumstances
3) NPCS have rich interactive behaviors
